-- so genericPoint is TOP.  coheight of top = 0.
example (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] : Order.coheight (genericPoint X) = 0 := by
  exact Order.coheight_eq_zero.mpr (by exact isMax_top)

-- hence stalk at generic point has ringKrullDim 0
example (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) = 0 := by
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight,
      Order.coheight_eq_zero.mpr (isMax_top)]
